description: This Java source file defines a logging utility class 'Log' that provides methods for logging messages at various severity levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It serves as a wrapper around Android's native logging system, allowing chaining of LogNode objects to handle log output and providing a consistent API for logging within the application.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that facilitates logging at different levels, manages the chain of LogNode objects, and provides static methods for log messages.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head of the LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode in the chain, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert/critical error message with optional throwable.
